zones.name: Kuzhi-Kalari (42x21ft pit)
zones.desc: Waist-deep pit, 2ft mud platform, 2x21ft nedum-thoon E/W, entry east-north, ola mats, Poothara SW 5-tier + Guruthara, Bhadrakali worship. Weapons between W-pillar and Poothara.
